title: Frequency Counter Pattern
definition: Using an object or Map to collect frequencies of values. This often avoids the need for nested loops (O(N^2)) when comparing two arrays or strings.
simpleExplanation: Instead of checking every letter of a word against another word, count how many A's, B's, and C's each word has, and just compare the counts.
